description: Na₁₂Ca₂Ta₄(SiO₄)₉ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-3.03 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.44 Å) and three longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.44 Å) and three longer (2.83 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.77 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.16 Å) and three longer (2.36 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.24 Å) and three longer (2.28 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (2.11 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.99 Å) and three longer (2.04 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the third Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.92 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the fourth Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.00 Å) and three longer (2.03 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.73 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra and corners with three TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-46°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.69 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra and corners with three TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-44°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃TaSi trigonal bipyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
